d:
Join us on an unforgettable day trip to Cairo, the vibrant capital of Egypt! In this travel vlog, we explore some of the most iconic landmarks in the Cairo. Whether you're planning your own Cairo day tour or just love to travel, this video is packed with history, culture, and local experiences.
Perfect for:
First-time Egypt travelers
Ancient history enthusiasts
Cultural explorers and vlog lovers
Travel Tips & Info:
Pyramid Entry Fees & Best Time to Visit: 700 EGP | 14 USD, Early morning between 7-9 AM
Abu Simbel Entry Fees : 765 EGP | 15 USD
